beforeImage.name: Toqlukuti'k Wind & Hydrogen
beforeImage.description: Toqlukuti'k is a renewable-energy and green-hydrogen development project in Newfoundland and Labrador. The project is intended to serve future hydrogen and derivative-fuel markets using a combination of onshore wind generation and downstream hydrogen infrastructure. The model is asset-heavy because it requires wind generation assets, transmission and process infrastructure, and large-scale industrial development. ABO Energy publicly announced in 2024 that CIP had acquired a 90 percent interest in the project while ABO retained 10 percent. Public materials therefore identify Energy Transition Fund I as the CIP sponsor and confirm the current disclosed ownership split.

milestones.event: ABO Energy announced that Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners had acquired a 90% interest in Toqlukuti'k.
ABO Energy disclosed that it retained a 10% interest in the project.

afterImage.name: Toqlukuti'k Wind & Hydrogen
aliases: Toqlukuti'k Avalon Isthmus Green Energy Project
afterImage.description: Toqlukuti'k Wind & Hydrogen is a pre-FID wind, hydrogen and green-ammonia development in Newfoundland and Labrador held through Toqlukuti'k Wind and Hydrogen Limited. On December 17, 2024, ABO Energy announced that Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners, through Copenhagen Infrastructure Energy Transition Fund I, had acquired 90% of the project company while ABO retained 10%; the party disclosures describe the acquisition as completed, although the exact legal closing date and holding vehicles were not published. Provincial filings describe a proposed 2.5–3.2 GW wind complex, 2.0–2.5 GW of electrolysis and associated ammonia, transmission, pipeline and storage infrastructure. The environmental assessment remains at the EIS-preparation stage, and the Crown-land reserve expired after February 28, 2026 because development conditions were not met. That lapse impaired the development right but did not establish an equity sale, cancellation or owner exit. No later ownership transfer, financing close, FID, construction start or signed pending transaction was identified through August 19, 2026. TQK facilities and land rights remain components of this one project-company record.
